name: tree_ring
notes: The deck of a platform built round a trunk, laid as a closed ring at a fixed height, with a knee brace every 2.5 m from under the deck's outer edge down to the trunk (left of the line, which round a ring laid anticlockwise is its outside). No rails of its own: the outer rail is `tree_rail`, laid in arcs so it can be broken where a walkway or a stair joins. Clears headroom through any foliage that grows into it.
